# Autodesk
> Autodesk provides professional software and cloud services for architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing, media, and design workflows.

Autodesk’s web presence spans product documentation, developer platforms, cloud APIs, education resources, support content, and industry-specific product hubs. This llms.txt emphasizes technical documentation, APIs, product help, learning resources, and support entry points most useful for language models.

## Developer Platform
- [Autodesk Platform Services](https://aps.autodesk.com/): Developer platform for building applications with Autodesk cloud APIs and services.
- [APS Documentation](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/docs/): Central documentation hub for Autodesk Platform Services APIs, SDKs, and tutorials.
- [APS API Reference](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/docs/): Reference and guides for authentication, data, model, and automation APIs.
- [APS Tutorials](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/docs/tutorials/): Step-by-step tutorials for common Autodesk Platform Services workflows.
- [APS Blog](https://aps.autodesk.com/blog): Product updates, technical articles, and announcements for Autodesk developers.
- [APS Support](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/support): Support resources for Autodesk Platform Services developers and API users.

## Autodesk Platform Services APIs
- [Authentication API](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/docs/oauth/v2/): OAuth 2.0 authentication for Autodesk Platform Services applications.
- [Data Management API](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/docs/data/v2/): Access, organize, and manage files and project data in Autodesk cloud services.
- [Model Derivative API](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/docs/model-derivative/v2/): Translate design files into viewable and extractable derivatives.
- [Viewer](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/docs/viewer/v7/): Web viewer for displaying and interacting with 2D and 3D models.
- [Design Automation API](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/docs/design-automation/v3/): Run Autodesk engine automation jobs in the cloud.
- [BIM 360 API](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/docs/bim360/v1/): APIs for BIM 360 project administration and document workflows.
- [ACC API](https://aps.autodesk.com/en/docs/acc/v1/): APIs for Autodesk Construction Cloud data and project integrations.

## Product Documentation
- [Autodesk Help](https://help.autodesk.com/): Main documentation portal for Autodesk products, services, and cloud tools.
- [AutoCAD Help](https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/ENU/): Official product help for AutoCAD features, commands, and workflows.
- [Revit Help](https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/ENU/): Official documentation for Revit architecture, structure, and MEP workflows.
- [Maya Help](https://help.autodesk.com/view/MAYAUL/ENU/): Product documentation for Maya modeling, animation, rendering, and scripting.
- [3ds Max Help](https://help.autodesk.com/view/3DSMAX/ENU/): Official help for 3ds Max modeling, visualization, and rendering tools.
- [Inventor Help](https://help.autodesk.com/view/INVNTOR/ENU/): Documentation for Inventor mechanical design and engineering workflows.
- [Fusion Help](https://help.autodesk.com/view/fusion360/ENU/): Product help for Fusion design, manufacturing, electronics, and collaboration.

## Product Support
- [Autodesk Support](https://www.autodesk.com/support): Central support portal for Autodesk products, accounts, and subscriptions.
- [Product Support Pages](https://www.autodesk.com/support/products): Browse support resources by Autodesk product.
- [Autodesk Account Support](https://www.autodesk.com/support/account): Help for sign-in, profile, licensing, and account administration.
- [Installation and Licensing Support](https://www.autodesk.com/support/download-install): Guidance for downloading, installing, and licensing Autodesk software.
- [Autodesk Community Support](https://www.autodesk.com/community): Community entry point for forums, learning, and peer support.
- [Autodesk Assistant](https://www.autodesk.com/support/contact-support): Contact and assisted support options for Autodesk customers.

## Learning and Training
- [Autodesk Learn](https://www.autodesk.com/learn): Learning hub for tutorials, courses, and product skill development.
- [Autodesk University](https://www.autodesk.com/autodesk-university/): Training sessions, classes, and industry learning content from Autodesk University.
- [Autodesk Design Academy](https://www.autodesk.com/education/edu-software/overview): Education-focused access point for Autodesk software and learning resources.
- [Autodesk Education](https://www.autodesk.com/education/home): Education portal for students, educators, institutions, and academic software access.
- [Fusion Learn](https://www.autodesk.com/products/fusion-360/learn-support): Learning and support resources for Fusion users.
- [AutoCAD Learning](https://www.autodesk.com/products/autocad/overview): Product entry point with access to AutoCAD learning resources.

## Architecture, Engineering, and Construction
- [Autodesk Construction Cloud](https://construction.autodesk.com/): Construction platform for project management, collaboration, and field execution.
- [BIM Collaborate](https://construction.autodesk.com/products/bim-collaborate/): Coordination and collaboration tools for multidisciplinary design teams.
- [Build](https://construction.autodesk.com/products/build/): Construction management software for field and project workflows.
- [Takeoff](https://construction.autodesk.com/products/takeoff/): Quantification and estimating tools for 2D and 3D construction takeoff.
- [Docs](https://construction.autodesk.com/products/docs/): Common data environment for document management and project collaboration.
- [Revit Product Page](https://www.autodesk.com/products/revit/overview): Product hub for BIM authoring, documentation, and multidisciplinary design.
- [Civil 3D Product Page](https://www.autodesk.com/products/civil-3d/overview): Product hub for civil engineering design and documentation workflows.

## Manufacturing and Product Design
- [Fusion](https://www.autodesk.com/products/fusion-360/overview): Integrated platform for CAD, CAM, CAE, electronics, and product development.
- [Inventor](https://www.autodesk.com/products/inventor/overview): Mechanical design and 3D engineering software for product development.
- [AutoCAD Product Page](https://www.autodesk.com/products/autocad/overview): Product hub for drafting, design, and documentation across industries.
- [Vault](https://www.autodesk.com/products/vault/overview): Product data management software for engineering teams and design files.
- [Netfabb](https://www.autodesk.com/products/netfabb/overview): Additive manufacturing software for design optimization and production preparation.
- [PowerMill](https://www.autodesk.com/products/powermill/overview): CAM software for high-speed and complex manufacturing machining workflows.

## Media and Entertainment
- [Maya](https://www.autodesk.com/products/maya/overview): 3D animation, modeling, simulation, and rendering software for artists.
- [3ds Max](https://www.autodesk.com/products/3ds-max/overview): 3D modeling, rendering, and visualization software for design professionals.
- [Arnold](https://www.autodesk.com/products/arnold/overview): Advanced renderer for film, television, games, and visualization pipelines.
- [Flame](https://www.autodesk.com/products/flame/overview): Visual effects, finishing, and color grading software for post-production.
- [ShotGrid](https://www.autodesk.com/products/shotgrid/overview): Production management software for media and entertainment pipelines.
- [MotionBuilder](https://www.autodesk.com/products/motionbuilder/overview): 3D character animation software for motion capture and virtual production.

## Community and Forums
- [Autodesk Community](https://www.autodesk.com/community): Community hub for forums, events, and peer engagement.
- [Autodesk Forums](https://forums.autodesk.com/): Product forums for troubleshooting, discussion, and user knowledge sharing.
- [AutoCAD Forum](https://forums.autodesk.com/t5/autocad-forum/bd-p/6): Community discussions and troubleshooting for AutoCAD users.
- [Revit Forum](https://forums.autodesk.com/t5/revit-architecture-forum/bd-p/202): Community discussions for Revit architecture and BIM workflows.
- [Fusion Forum](https://forums.autodesk.com/t5/fusion-support-forum/bd-p/962): Support discussions and troubleshooting for Fusion users.
- [Maya Forum](https://forums.autodesk.com/t5/maya-forum/bd-p/area-c-maya): Community discussions for Maya artists and technical users.
